caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects placed on a blank, light-colored background. Each object consists of a horizontal, rounded wooden plank, into which two diagonal, roughly hewn wooden beams are fixed to form an “X” shape. The beams are fastened to the horizontal planks with nails or bolts, visible as small round metal spots. The wood appears weathered with a mixture of greenish-gray and brown hues, suggesting age and use. Around each structure, brown leather straps with buckles are attached, one strap being fully extended and the other partially wrapped around the object. There are fine details in the wood grain, the metal fastenings, and the stitching on the leather, with shadows cast on the pale background emphasizing the three-dimensional form of the objects.
title: Pack Saddle
